record.body:
## Rationale

The pain was reported on the web dashboard. The snapshot already exposes milestones; only `dashboard/web/ui` needs to consume them. Changing Textual in the same phase would widen Landing and verification without helping the reported surface.

## Counter-argument

TUI parity in the same phase would keep both surfaces aligned. That was rejected as out of scope for web-calm unless the user reopens it; later phases can revisit Textual if needed.

payload.alternatives: Also change the Textual phase selector in this phase
payload.choice: Implement milestone grouping only in dashboard/web/ui; Textual unchanged
